notes.title: Version 1.6.1 - Slavic gods
notes.notes:
Meet Slavic gods, discover how to awake them and unleash their power.

Gods:

- Peron 
- Swarog 
- Dziewanna 
- Jarowit
- Swiatowit

Each of gods must be awaken, then it contributes to fighting it's own way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31664964/5242d86aa84b45e16d18bacb26829849b2ca9f81.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.4-1.4.1 - Advanced Crafting!
notes.notes:
Gather recipes, magic dust and craft powerful equipment.
New panel inside the game allows you to do it continent way.
The mechanism is done as a game plug-in, so if you have programming skills
you can provide your own crafting engine!
Details how to do it will be provided in the game discussion panel.

Ver. 1.4.1 has some bug fixes and game balance fixes.

Have fun!

notes.title: Versions 1.3.4-1.3.6
notes.notes:
Few enhancements, most of them were requested/suggested by players.

- standard Unity dialog allowing to customize keys now available at startup
- Merchant's inventory items hero can't afford are now clearly marked  
- Any inventory items better than equipped by a hero are now clearly marked 
- Weapons Types are described when hero collects the first weapon
- New enchanting possible: Toadstool + health/mana potion = permanent stat enhance potion

Have fun!

Regards,
Tom
